Title: Clean Exit
Premise_Logline: The family's bookkeeper holds the one ledger that can free her brother or bury him — and the investigator closing the case is the only man she cannot afford to trust.
A_Plot: A works her exit from the family's operation using the ledger as leverage while B's task-force case closes around it.
B_Plot: D stages a threat against A's brother to force her silence; C's called-in passage debt turns A's only confidant into the family's leverage.

consent negotiation before first C3 contact

Hook_Line: She keeps the family's books. He's building the case that burns them. Only one of them walks away clean.
Blurb_Draft: I keep the family's books. Every debt, every favor, every quiet correction — priced in my handwriting. The ledger I hide could clear my brother or convict him, depending on who reads it first, and I planned to be gone before anyone did. Then the task force sent him: an investigator with a dead partner behind him and a warrant in front of him, asking questions like he already owns the answers. He's supposed to dismantle everything I've balanced. I'm supposed to be the thread he pulls. The family gave me one order: stay quiet. His people gave him one case: close it. Neither of us was issued instructions for this.
Locale_Signature: river ice breaking under the Kinzie Street rail bridge
a green banker's lamp over ruled paper in the restaurant's back office
Occupation_Primary_A: bookkeeper for the family's front businesses
Goal_Internal_A: a life that is hers to keep, unpriced and unowed
Wound_A: complicity debt: her bookkeeping put her brother within reach of conviction
Flaw_A: preemptive withdrawal: she leaves people before they can be taken from her
Secret_A: holds the ledger that convicts her brother
Backstory_A: Raised inside the family's restaurant business; took over the books at twenty-two when her father's hands failed; has balanced its accounts, and its silences, ever since.
Physical_Description_A: Dark hair pinned for work; ink-stained fingers; a stillness that reads as calm until it reads as warning.
Voice_Verbal_Tic_A: answers dangerous questions with smaller questions
Body_Language_Default_A: goes still; lays both hands flat on the nearest surface
Fear_Profile_A: exposure of the ledger; her brother sentenced; being the one left behind
Goal_External_B: close the case without burning A
Goal_Internal_B: keep one person out of the wreckage this time
Wound_B: betrayed partnership: the partner he trusted sold their last case and a witness died for it
Flaw_B: procedural armour: hides behind protocol so he never has to trust his own judgment of people
Secret_B: the investigation already touches A's ledger
Backstory_B: Second-generation law enforcement; his last major case collapsed when his partner sold it; he requested the family's file himself.
Physical_Description_B: Broad and deliberate; a suit worn like procedure.
Voice_Verbal_Tic_B: cites the regulation instead of the reason
Body_Language_Default_B: watches hands before faces; squares to doorways
Fear_Profile_B: repeating the betrayal; getting a source killed
Subplot_A: C's passage debt is called in, turning A's only confidant into the family's leverage
Subplot_B: the brother's pretrial clock sets every party's deadline
Cover_Cue_Main: suited male figure from behind, half in shadow, city river at night
Cover_Cue_Background: frozen river and bridge lights, falling snow
Back_Cover_Copy: Every debt in the family's ledger is priced in her handwriting. The investigator sent to collect has one case to close, one vow to keep - and no line item for her.
Dedication_Line: For everyone who kept the books, kept the peace, and finally stopped.
Content_Warnings_Public: threats and coercion by third parties
